messages.author: 35cc05aa9805e372
messages.subject: No display in Trelliscope
parts:
I am running Debian Wheezy (7.8) on two different systems (laptop and server).   I am unable to get Trelliscope to display any information using your sample scripts for Housing Data and Census data.  These systems are running R 3.1.2.

I have also run your script emr-3.2.1 and successfully installed Rstudio on an AWS cluster.  The individual graphics in your sample scripts work in both R and Rstudio on both local and AWS machines. 

Running view() launches the browser with an unpopulated trelliscope. I have also tried opening up the permissions on the display directories.

Stand-alone shiny examples work on all my machines.  I have turned off all browser add-ons. 

I would like to include Trelliscope in an upcoming demo I am doing, but I can't find any documentation on the Tessera site about requirements/settings for Trelliscope to understand what might be causing the problem.

Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Ryan W

messages.author: 2f3428d3166aad1c
messages.subject: Re: No display in Trelliscope
parts:
Hi Ryan,

Thanks for posting.  A recent update to shiny on CRAN has caused some trouble with Trelliscope.  I have updated Trelliscope and I and others have been testing it for the past few days.  It looks good so I just merged it.  If you reinstall from tesseradata/trelliscope, that will hopefully solve your problem.  If it doesn’t, please let us know and we’ll help you figure out what might be causing the problem.

Thanks!

Ryan
